resolved_findings.finding: Enum render metadata could remain stale after a representation transform.
resolved_findings.resolution: Refresh classification at finalization; regressions check changed membership and changed shape.

resolved_findings.finding: Object identity metadata could become incompatible with represented fields or union payloads.
resolved_findings.resolution: Validate the assumptions used by Object impl emission, while retaining optional IDs on ordinary untagged structs.

resolved_findings.finding: Directory-only output trees could falsely establish parity with zero files.
resolved_findings.resolution: Reject empty file inventories; exercise positive, changed/added/removed, and directory-only CLI cases.

resolved_findings.finding: The represented dependency engine imposed unconditional legacy Shared edges.
resolved_findings.resolution: Default assembly explicitly adds legacy facade dependencies; the general engine derives represented and export uses only.

resolved_findings.finding: Configuration errors omitted paths, and some diagnostics exposed numeric handles.
resolved_findings.resolution: Preserve path context and resolve names for user-facing diagnostics.

resolved_findings.finding: Freezing component layout repeated checks guaranteed by its own copy loop.
resolved_findings.resolution: Use a fallible collect that retains missing-assignment errors.

design_decisions: Retain the lightweight allocation/finalization boundary and Copy run-local crate handles.
Keep compatibility dependency selection explicit without introducing a general policy framework.
Preserve existing specialized enum naming; supported inference labels can differ from rendered component identifiers.
input_provenance: Same pinned v2494 input and formatter as neutral_refactor_validation.json; production pins and configuration unchanged.
